    Twisted traces of type E_6 #

    Appendix A, "Type E_6 and the small-period exclusion". The arms have one, two and two vertices; x is the closed path along the short arm and p, q the others, so x + p + q = 0 and x² = p³ = q³ = 0. With v = p - q = x + 2p, "adding and subtracting the cubic relations gives x² = 0, v³ = -xvx, v²x + vxv + xv² = 0", and the words x, v; xv, vx, v²; xvx, xv², vxv; xvxv, vxv²; xvxv² span the positive part, with all words of degree six zero.
